Vielen Dank fürs spielen meines Projekte:
Thank you for playing my project. You should know that I am not a game developer or a software designer.

I had the idea for After Play when anomaly games were becoming hugely popular.

At the time, I knew nothing about creating games like this. Months of learning, understanding and putting things into practice followed. With a lot of help from good friends, online asset libraries and AI-created content such as pictures and music, I was finally able to release my first game.

It is not perfect or free of mistakes, but it is my first milestone in developing my very own game.
